description: A multi-step walk in which an intermediate candidate FAILS after invoking the resolver. en-001's Article deliberately omits the PHONETIC_CONSONANT branch that the resolver returns when handed en-001, so that candidate raises IllegalStateException at DefaultStrings.java:1181 AFTER the resolver call has been made and recorded; the fixture policy is any-failure so the walk continues to en, whose Article carries every branch. resolverCalls therefore holds one entry PER CANDIDATE, each with a different locale. Per-call policy overrides on this same fixture truncate the walk at chosen points so the calls that must NOT happen are observable too.
